definitions: A historic bridge in Paris, France, spanning the Seine River.
Known for its ornate Art Nouveau lamps, cherubs, nymphs, and winged horses.
Connects the Grand Palais and Petit Palais on the Right Bank with Les Invalides on the Left Bank.
examples: The Pont Alexandre III offers stunning views of the Eiffel Tower.
Tourists often photograph the intricate details of the Pont Alexandre III.
Walking across the Pont Alexandre III is a quintessential Parisian experience.
